kind_of_thing.quote: Garlic (Allium sativum) is a species of bulbous flowering plants in the genus Allium.

extinct.why: Garlic is a plant that is widely cultivated and eaten today, so it is still living.

kind_of_plant.why: Garlic is a bulbous plant grown and eaten as a food, like an onion, so a parent would call it a vegetable.

part_we_eat.quote: The part of the garlic plant that people eat is called the head or bulb. It grows at the bottom of a long green stalk.

read_by.rule: every value carries a sentence found word for word in the saved page
